basis: 13G/13F position in a listed company, no private round naming the firm (T3, D3). Sunrun listed in August 2015; Tiger's 13F carries it only from 2018-03-31 and its 13G and Form 3/4 filings run 2018 to 2021, so the holding was bought on the market.

basis: The seed headline is about Zomato, a rival ('Zomato raises $103 million from Tiger Global, closes in on Swiggy'); the row's other headlines (UrbanPiper's round, a Swiggy vs Zomato comparison) name no Tiger investment in Swiggy, and a Bing News query for Swiggy with Tiger Global found none: no record ties the firm to a round.

Lee Fixel (Tiger partner, in tenure) is director on Sympoz Inc.'s Form D filings of 2012, 2013 and 2014 (Craftsy, Denver); Wikipedia names Tiger Global Management among the investors of the company's $15M round and Vox (2017) names Tiger Global among Craftsy's early investors.

note: Sympoz Inc. is Craftsy. NBCUniversal bought a majority stake in May 2017 for about $230M (Vox: https://www.vox.com/2017/5/12/15628592/nbcuniversal-craftsy-acquisition-price-230-million); the business, renamed Bluprint, closed in 2020 and TN Marketing bought its assets. The entry stage stays with the Form D band (April 2012 round).

basis: Wikipedia (Takealot Group): in October 2010 Kim Reid and Tiger Global Management acquired the existing business Take2 and renamed it takealot.com. Tiger with its co-investor bought the whole company: a control purchase, not a venture round (COLLECTION.md 1, T3 control positions). Naspers took a majority in 2017 and all of it in 2018.

note: Tiger co-led the $20M Series A with Index Ventures in November 2022 (Tech.eu, Business Wire). Agrees with Balderton's row (Berlin, DE).
